description: This file defines the EnforcePasswordRequest entity class for managing password enforcement requests within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for storing user association, request date, reset code, and expiration status, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EnforcePasswordRequest
classes.description: Entity class representing a password enforcement request, including user details, request date, reset code, and expiration status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the password enforcement request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the password enforcement request.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User associated with this password enforcement request.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User with this password enforcement request.

methods.name: getResetRequestDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the password reset was requested.

methods.name: setResetRequestDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the password reset request.

methods.name: getResetCode
methods.description: Returns the reset code used for password reset.

methods.name: setResetCode
methods.description: Sets the reset code for password reset.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the password reset request has expired.

methods.name: setExpired
methods.description: Sets the expiration status of the password reset request.
